PLAN "Integrated 12-Week Fat Loss, Glycemic Control, IF Optional, Fasted Cardio, Cheat Meals, Phase 3 Intensity"

TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve metabolic health, fat loss, and glycemic control while preserving lean mass"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Foundation and technique":
        warmup:
          walking 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_curl 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progression and technique":
        warmup:
          walking 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Volume for adaptation":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload week and technique":
        warmup:
          walking 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 2x30 seconds per side
        cooldown:
          full_body stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progressive overload and conditioning":
        warmup:
          rowing 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          concentration_curl 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Glycemic control emphasis":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_pulldown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpo 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Intensity build with conditioning":
        warmup:
          row 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          military_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Activation and recovery week":
        warmup:
          walking 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 3 Intro: Push Intensity Increase":

          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 3 Progression: Increase Load and Density":
        warmup:
          row 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          front_squat 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds

          lat_stretch 60 seconds

          bench_press 3x5..7 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds

          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 3 Deload and Consolidation":
        warmup:
          walking 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 2x30 seconds per side
        cooldown:
          full_body stretch 5 minutes

  PLAN "Nutrition and Diabetes Management Guidance"
  TYPE informational
  VISIBILITY public

NUTRITION_GUIDANCE
  - Calorie target: moderate deficit of 300–500 kcal/day below maintenance, tailored to individual TDEE; adjust based on weekly weight change (aim -0.5 to -1.0 kg per 2 weeks initially).
  - Macronutrient distribution: protein 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day to preserve lean mass; carbohydrates distributed evenly across meals with emphasis on high-fiber sources; fats 25–35% of total calories.
  - Protein timing: include 25–40 g protein per meal, especially post-workout within 2 hours.
  - Carbohydrate quality: emphasize low glycemic index foods, steady carbs around workouts; prioritize non-starchy vegetables, whole grains, legumes.
  - Fiber target: 25–38 g/day.
  - Fluid: 2.5–3.5 liters/day, adjust for activity and climate.
  - Glycemic targets (typical): fasting glucose 80–130 mg/dL; postprandial <180 mg/dL 2 hours after meals; HbA1c goal around <7% or individualized per clinician.
  - Exercise and metformin: physical activity improves glycemic control; monitor for hypoglycemia, especially around workouts; consider carbohydrate snack if fasting glucose is high or if on peak metformin effect.
  - Meal timing: regular meals; avoid large late-night meals; distribute carbohydrates evenly to support glycemic control.
  - Snacking: choose protein + fiber rich snacks to maintain satiety and glycemic stability.
  - Alcohol: if consumed, limit and pair with meals; discuss with clinician.
  - Sleep: 7–9 hours to support metabolic health.
  - Monitoring: weekly self-monitoring of weight, mood, energy, and blood glucose as advised by clinician; adjust plan accordingly.

NUTRITIONAL_MEASURES
  - Breakfast example: Greek yogurt (or Greek-style dairy-free alternative) with berries and a sprinkle of nuts; 20–30 g protein.
  - Lunch example: grilled chicken or tofu, quinoa or lentils, mixed vegetables, olive oil dressing.
  - Dinner example: salmon or tempeh, sweet potato, steamed greens.
  - Snack example: apple with peanut butter; cottage cheese or string cheese; hummus with veggie sticks.
  - Carbohydrate distribution around workouts:
    - Pre-workout: a small amount of slow-digesting carbs if energy is needed (e.g., yogurt with fruit) 30–60 minutes before training.
    - Post-workout: protein + carbohydrate (e.g., protein shake + banana) within 1–2 hours after training.

FASTED_CARDIO
  - Fasted morning cardio: perform 2–4 sessions per week, 20–35 minutes each, at an easy to moderate pace (RPE 5–6), after overnight fast and before breakfast, on days without resistance training or non-fatigue days.
  - Modalities: walking, cycling, or rowing.
  - Hydration: optional black coffee or water; avoid sugary drinks.
  - Safety: monitor for dizziness or hypoglycemia; if fasting glucose <80 mg/dL or user feels unwell, skip fasted cardio and have a light refuel snack.

IF_CONSIDERATIONS
  - Intermittent fasting plan remains available; Phase 3 intensity push can be tuned to IF schedule; ensure eating window aligns with training times and clinician guidance.

CHEAT_MEALS
  - Structure: 1 cheat meal per week, planned, not binge; fits within weekly energy target.
  - Timing: typically on a lower-intensity training day or rest day to minimize impact on glycemic control; avoid immediately before high-intensity sessions.
  - Composition guidance: allow typical foods but prioritize protein experience and portion control; keep fiber-rich veggie portions, choose lean proteins, and limit ultra-processed items when possible.
  - Recovery plan: resume normal nutrition next meal; consider a slightly higher protein intake after to support satiety and lean mass preservation.

CAUTION and DIABETES_SAFETY
  - Monitor for signs of hypoglycemia during or after workouts; carry quick carbohydrates if risk exists.
  - Consult with healthcare provider before starting any new supplement or if HbA1c is above target; adjust metformin dosing as advised by clinician.
  - Avoid high-sugar, highly processed foods; minimize refined carbs to support glycemic control.
  - Ensure warm-up and cool-down are included to reduce cardiovascular strain.

PROGRAM NOTES
  - Week-to-week progression: adjust weights by approximately 2.5–5% weekly if able; prioritize form and safety.
  - Equipment: full gym access; exercises listed use canonical names only.
  - Reps/sets follow the WPL-AI syntax precisely (e.g., 3x8..12 rpe 7; rest 90 seconds).
  - Cardio modalities: walking, cycling, rowing, or other available options as warm-up/cooldown or conditioning days.

END PLAN
